mobile_maia_reference.scope_note: Inspected pinned reference; do not assert this is the current Mobile Maia release.

ec_rule.brilliant: played root is first, best-versus-second mapped gap >10 percentage points, EC sacrifice true, mapped loss <=5
ec_rule.interesting: EC sacrifice outside unique-best branch and after cp >-200
ec_rule.sacrifice: nonterminal and M(before) > -M(after) +100; every legal root followed by capture-only material qsearch

mute_v2_rule.sacrifice: legal non-pawn non-king piece offer; no EC material fallback
mute_v2_rule.offer_test: Opponent best legal same-square capture exchange gain > max(0, mover material after minus before) +100. Capture/promotion gains are credited; either side can stop local exchange.
mute_v2_rule.routine_win_veto: another evaluated non-sacrificing root at >=+600 cp mover
mute_v2_rule.earlier_EC_sacrifice_labels: Clear EC !! or !? when legal-offer test fails; keep negative classifications; otherwise retained fallback labels apply.
mute_v2_rule.corroboration: whole current/prior or independent matching-quality nonshallower decision window; withheld is not an award
mute_v2_rule.known_limit: same-square offer test can miss recoup on another square; current two-PV relevance gate does not examine every safe alternative

baseline_state.score_mapping: W(cp)=100/(1+exp(-0.00368208*cp)); cp normalized to mover and clamped [-1000,1000]; mate win/loss mapped to +/-1000. This is a heuristic, not a calibrated outcome probability or Chess.com formula.

sampling.primary_source: primary-moves.json after explicit fresh labels and PGN validation
sampling.gallery_label_disagreements: retain as separate reserve evidence; replace positive until 60 current Brilliants per account
sampling.gallery_positive_categories: prefer 15 each queen/rook/bishop/knight per account; record actual memberships
sampling.negative_controls: separate unique same-player moves, prefer capture/exchange, quiet defense and mistakes/misses; select explicit current labels, absence is unknown
sampling.excluded_games_source: exclude-games.json; old pilot and all original regression examples remain development evidence outside new primary600
negative_enrichment_priority: apparent legal nonpawn piece offers under unchanged current-v2 predicate
quiet attacked and defended nonpawn pieces
sampling.negative_enrichment_limits: Candidates are unknown until fresh current label; apparent offers may be Brilliants. Report actual achieved categories; no easy-negative-only claim.

holdout.player_holdout: Any game with Hikaru as either player
holdout.policy_evaluation: Only unchanged pinned EC and Mute v2; no thresholds chosen on this study

fixed_engine_plan.positions_per_target: preceding,before,after (target ply-2,ply-1,ply); full PGN history retained
fixed_engine_plan.multipv: Two legal distinct root moves when available; only complete exact same-depth iterations
fixed_engine_plan.prior_iteration: Actual preceding completed iteration; never fabricated equal-depth score copies
fixed_engine_plan.cache: Reuse only exact engine/script/budget/PGN/FEN identities; one saved snapshot per game/position/budget
fixed_engine_plan.hash_sessions: Clear hash and new session per game/budget; requested positions in forward game order
fixed_engine_plan.terminal_positions: Explicit terminal snapshots; no engine node charge

stronger_subset_predeclaration.universe: Primary600 baseline confirmed award mismatches to fresh binary label only
stronger_subset_predeclaration.selection: If <=30 mismatches, all. Otherwise take up to15 FP and up to15 FN, each sorted by SHA256(game_id+":"+ply) ascending; fill unused slots from remaining mismatches in same hash order. No manual choices.
stronger_subset_predeclaration.timing: Write stronger-subset.json and hash before starting stronger engine searches
stronger_subset_predeclaration.budget: 1500000 nodes per position, complete same-depth full windows only
stronger_subset_predeclaration.report: Report baseline metrics on all600; stronger subset is budget-sensitivity evidence, never silently substitutes scores in primary totals

feature_review_plan.purpose: Descriptive error analysis; no new rule or tuned threshold
fields: legal offered piece and immediate capture credit
all-square capture recoup line and physical material outcome
capture sequence length/depth and temporary material deficit
game phase from move number and material with definition recorded
feature_review_plan.limits: Capture-only material probes are heuristic; no automatic veto without held-out validation. Conditional recoup lines distinguished from played moves.

metrics.primary: TP,FN,FP,TN, detection rate, selected-control false-positive rate
metrics.uncertainty: Selected strong-player gallery sample is not a population prevalence estimate. Report denominators and zero/unknown as such.
metrics.award_stages: Raw eligibility, confirmation-aware award and withheld counts separate
metrics.sensitivity: Independent stronger-window decisions and corroboration of baseline decisions separate

owner_regression_controls.name: L1lChap-nelsi 14...Ndxe5
owner_regression_controls.mechanism: same-square loss on e5 is recouped on d3; two knights for knight+bishop plus pawn
owner_regression_controls.new_evidence_status: Separate post-pilot browser review reported by parent; outside new600 and pilot metrics

owner_regression_controls.name: 41.Qf5+
owner_regression_controls.mechanism: EC material probe treats deferred optional promotion gain as sacrifice; no legal immediate nonpawn capture after check

owner_regression_controls.name: 17...Bf5
owner_regression_controls.mechanism: defended tactic; capture-only probe misses quiet Rd1+

runtime_setup.python: Python 3 with python-chess available; script also recognizes this session’s temporary dependency directory as a fallback. Install dependencies yourself in an isolated environment; no package/deployment framework is supplied.
runtime_setup.engine: Stockfish18 binary is currently explicitly pinned at /opt/homebrew/bin/stockfish with recorded SHA256. Moving/changing the binary path requires a new collector artifact/output; cached evidence is reused only when engine hash and collector script hash agree.
runtime_setup.typescript: Node24 and tsx loader, plus chessops0.15.1. Pinned classifier/core source files and import shim are relative paths. Point reference/current-v2/node_modules at an existing compatible node_modules directory; the session symlink is replaceable and not a dependency on /private/tmp.
runtime_setup.no_live_app_dependency: The old /private/tmp native application checkout is not modified. Its preinstalled runtime dependencies were reused only to avoid a package framework.
